name: mcpviews-tribex-crm-plugin
description: MCPViews plugin for the TribeX CRM service, including a compact CRM renderer and local MCP bridge.

scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/tribex-crm.zip && zip -q -r dist/tribex-crm.zip manifest.json package.json renderers src tests docs README.md AGENTS.md
scripts.check: node --check src/*.mjs && node --check tests/*.mjs && node --check renderers/*.js
